fato_historico: 1823: American fur trapper Hugh Glass is mauled by a grizzly bear while on an expedition in South Dakota.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to channel your innate Virgo precision today. Much like a story of survival against the wild, you may find that your persistence allows you to overcome any obstacles. Consider this a time to heal, gather your strength, and focus on the details that truly nurture your spirit and your path forward.
frase_do_dia: Strength is found in the quiet persistence of your beautiful, detail-oriented soul.
significado_numero: Represents the power of introspection and inner wisdom for your journey.
conselho: Trust in your ability to mend and grow stronger through every challenge.
